## Philosophy

Agents do the repetitive work. Humans own the decisions.
IT exists to enable people, not gatekeep them.
Every agent gets an identity, least-privilege access, an audit trail and an offboarding date.
Requests are opportunities - security comes from good controls, not from saying no.
